execution.executor: root only; identity and command to be frozen before authorization
execution.providerRetry: Existing runtime may retry at most once inside the original per-input/shared provider limits; every attempt counts. No harness retries, input reruns or campaign restarts.
execution.environment: NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 for actual Node provider requests; keys from environment never printed or saved
execution.ledger: Root must reserve one exclusive campaign-level journal before first dispatch and refuse any second run identity/output path for this plan. Uncertain dispatch counts as consumed; do not resume.
execution.onFailure: Preserve first report/journal and unexecuted cases. No retries beyond declared existing provider policy. No replacement cases or removed denominator.
execution.publication: Sanitized report only; private control text, prompts, credentials and raw private context excluded.

requirements: Freeze clean exact post-implementation commit and full dependency/source hash in isolated immutable worktree.
Freeze exact plan/manifest bytes and ordered cases; independently verify helper-generated outgoing text equals approvedRetrieval.
Freeze runner command/source, adapter settings, limits and one executor identity; no production edits after freeze.
Run applicable full gate and independent adverse regression review before granting campaign authorization.
Consume no historical authorization and invoke no completed study.

prospectiveCriteria.fullyVerifiedMetric: Report independently fully selected-set verified correct definitive / 8 separately from raw correct definitive / 8. Target >=6/8 fully verified for a useful development observation, without readiness claim. One inaccessible/unsupported selected citation denies full selected-set credit; no substitution with unselected evidence.
prospectiveCriteria.denominatorRule: All eight eligible inputs remain, including admission misses, abstentions, provider/transport failures, timeouts, blocked dispatch and unexecuted cases. Controls scored separately as exact admission/presentation/zero-retrieval, not factual coverage.
stopRules: Any wrong definitive, unsafe query attempt, source-freeze mismatch, checkpoint failure, global budget exhaustion, unknown completed Jev usage or unbounded/cancellation regression stops further dispatch.
Preserve all original output. Any post-run discovered citation fault remains a failure; no rerun or retrospective case exclusion.
reportRequired: Every per-case action, exact admitted span, verdict/reason and selected IDs.

Raw correct definitive, fully selected-set verified correct definitive, wrong definitive, abstentions, admission/no-verdict/operational/not-run counts with denominators; truth polarity and domain strata.
Agent inspection record for every selected URL/excerpt: exact proposition/scope, retained excerpt hash, substantive grounding, provenance/dependence, access status/time and methods.

Actual attempts and usage, unknown reservations/charges, request bytes and explicit unmeasured response-byte totals (per-response size protection remains), observed latency including timeouts, partial costs and first-run journal.
Any model/provider errors distinguished from successfully completed insufficient evidence.

limitations: Purposive small OPEN cohort; no blind accuracy or production readiness inference.
No baseline arm: improvements cannot be attributed causally to source-quality changes.

This fact cohort does not calibrate adverse source semantics; bare repetition, title-only prestige, copied/common-origin, attribution/promotion, scope/qualifier mismatch and high-risk behavior require independent adversarial validation.
Truth-reference inspection does not verify the sources the runtime actually selects or their independence.
All prior NEW24/canonical studies are completed and must never be rerun or resumed.
Campaign response-byte aggregate is not recorded by the existing runner and must be reported unmeasured; per-response size guards do not provide an aggregate measurement.

publication.redaction: Raw authored inputs omitted, including synthetic private controls. Public admitted span allowlists and all prospective expected labels/criteria retained. This projection is not the frozen executable plan.
publication.authorization: Consumed by first run; no resume or rerun.
